name: kairn
description: Context-aware knowledge engine for AI - memory, graph, intelligent routing.
long_description: Kairn is an air-gapped, zero-dependency knowledge engine exposed over MCP. It stores decisions, patterns, gotchas and preferences as a queryable graph with full-text recall, so an agent can retrieve prior context before acting and save what it learns afterwards. All data stays in a local SQLite workspace on the user's machine.

workspace.title: Kairn workspace
workspace.description: Directory holding the Kairn database. Everything Kairn stores stays inside it and never leaves this machine.
